crossRefs.note: “Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you. Before you were born, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to…
Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.
Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”
You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

translations.web: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, “A boy is born to you,” making him very glad.
translations.bsb: Cursed be the man who brought my father the news, saying, “A son is born to you,” bringing him great joy.
translations.kjv: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
translations.asv: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man-child is born unto thee; making him very glad.
